name: Bistro Oggi corner
observations: Dark teal/green painted two-storey corner building with gold BISTRO OGGI lettering.
Lower dark framed windows and doorway have pale/stone-like surround details; side window looks onto junction.
Simple rectangular light/dark upper windows and dark roof/gutter.
Facade wraps around angled corner, not a single rectangular photo plane.
Road signs, zebra approach, double yellow lines and kerb turn provide important surrounding shape.
Door can remain closed frontage proxy; restaurant interior is not established.
